name: Bharatam Mechatronics Private Limited
india_angle: Bharatam Mechatronics is an India-based company established in 2014, indicating a strong local presence.
summary: Bharatam Mechatronics specializes in the design and development of custom-built turnkey projects, including test systems and data acquisition systems, which are relevant to semiconductor testing and measurement. Their expertise in automation and electronics supports various engineering domains, including the semiconductor industry.
